logical_identity: canonical provider locator plus approved method-specific routes for the same S3 bucket/key, strong opaque ETag and exact object length
get_signature_lifetime: advertised by its own Expires field; bounded reuse derives from that GET route only
authorization: private caller-owned netrc; explicit login origin only; never forwarded from another host
cookies: separate memory-only jars per exact origin, including port; none to signed resource
redirects: verified HTTPS, exact directed edges and destination paths; no Referer or environment proxy; at most 8 hops
route_reuse: GET only; min(60 seconds, advertised expiry minus 30 seconds); unknown expiry means fresh canonical resolution
refresh: one canonical re-resolution on 401/403 per logical attempt; login rejection and 412 fail immediately
retries: three logical attempts for existing transient statuses and transport/body failures; Retry-After at most two seconds; 30-second wire timeout and 10-second connect timeout
cancellation: 20 ms polling while awaiting authenticated headers or body; stream cancellation joins its producer
source_mutation: strong ETag, exact size and method route checks; terminal authenticated failure invalidates the binding even after a server restores its earlier version
diagnostics: static error categories, method/status/origin counters only; signed URLs, authorization and cookie values never emitted
scope: one explicitly configured native HDF5 object; anonymous default and other format adapters unchanged

earlier_failed_attempt.wire_hop_counts: unavailable in that diagnostic build; excluded from accepted-run totals
